                the last name. Carries no sequence number and is stable for a given identity.
              type: string

                owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Assigned

I have a complete map. Here is my report.

# Complete Map: customerCode / membershipNumber / memberId Refactor

The entire concept surface lives in one Java package (`.../rest/function/owner/`), the `Owner` model, the `OwnerMapper`, the OpenAPI/DB schemas, and two acceptance-test files. There is a single, deliberately-central indirection point (`OwnerIdentity`) already set up for this unification.

---

## 1. Core identity-formatting helpers

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/CustomerCode.java`
The definition of the customer code `<REGION>-<HASH8>`.
- `format(region, telephone, lastName)` (L28-30): builds `region + "-" + hash8(...)`.
- `deduplicate(code, inUse)` (L41-51): appends `-<n>` (n≥2) on collision.
- `region(customerCode)` (L55-61): extracts the text before the first `-`.
- `hash8(telephone, lastName)` (L64-66): `Sha256.hex(telephone + lastName, 8)` — the HASH8. `HASH_LENGTH = 8` (L17).

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Sha256.java`
Shared SHA-256 util. `hex(value, length)` (L21-28) returns first `length` UPPER-case hex chars (used by CustomerCode HASH8 and Household id); `hexLower(value)` (L31-38) returns full 64-char lower-case digest (used by IdentityKey).

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Luhn.java`
`checkDigit(String value)` (L17-36): standard Luhn check digit (0-9) over the digits in the input; ignores non-digits so it runs directly over a formatted customerCode. Computed on read, not stored.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/FiscalYear.java`
Fiscal year starts 1 July. `startYear` (L26-29), `shortYear` (L33-35, the `YY`), `label` (L39-41, `"FY<YY>"`), `between` (L45-47). Javadoc (L14-15) explicitly says it feeds "the membership number's year segment and the `fiscalYear` field (both via `OwnerMapper`)" plus Tenure.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Locality.java`
Region resolution. `UNKNOWN` marker (L18), `CITY_REGION` table Sydney→NSW/Melbourne→VIC/Brisbane→QLD (L21-22), `KNOWN_REGIONS` {NSW,VIC,QLD} (L25), `isKnown` (L32-34), `region(city)` (L38-40), `region(city, postcode)` (L44-47, postcode range first, else city).

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Postcode.java`
`REGION_RANGE` NSW 2000-2099 / VIC 3000-3099 / QLD 4000-4099 (L16-18); `region(postcode)` (L43-55) maps a postcode to a region.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerSegment.java`
The "owner segment". `of(membershipLevel, region)` (L21-25): `<TIER>_<AREA>`; TIER = PREMIUM if membershipLevel≥3 else STANDARD; AREA = METRO if `Locality.isKnown(region)` else REGIONAL. Pure/derived, not stored.

---

## 2. The central indirection point (most important for your refactor)

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerIdentity.java`
`primary(Owner owner)` (L18-20) returns `owner.getCustomerCode()`. The class Javadoc (L5-11) is written for exactly your task: "when the customerCode is later unified into the memberId, changing this one method makes every consumer (the `OwnerCreatedEvent` included) carry the memberId instead." This is the single seam the audit event goes through.

---

## 3. Pipeline step that assigns the code

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerCustomerCode.java`
`service(owner, ownerRepository)` (L24-34): derives region via `Locality.region(city, postcode)`, formats via `CustomerCode.format`, collects all existing `getCustomerCode()` values into an in-use set, then `owner.setCustomerCode(CustomerCode.deduplicate(...))`. Wired into the create pipeline (see officefloor yml below). Runs after telephone normalization so the hash is over the E.164 value.

---

## 4. Storage — the `Owner` model and DB schemas

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`
- Field: `@Column(name = "customer_code") private String customerCode;` (L74-75).
- Accessors `getCustomerCode` / `setCustomerCode` (L178-184).
- No stored `membershipNumber`/`checkDigit`/`fiscalYear`/`ownerSegment`/`memberId` — all derived in the mapper. Related stored fields: `membershipPoints` (L83-84), `membershipLevel` (L86-87).

### DB schema (column `customer_code VARCHAR(20)` / `TEXT`):
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/db/h2/schema.sql:45`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/db/hsqldb/schema.sql:52`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/db/mysql/schema.sql:42`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/db/postgres/schema.sql:40`

(Also `membership_points` / `membership_level` columns nearby in each.) Note: `data.sql` seed files contain no customer_code values — codes are assigned at creation. If unifying into `memberId`, the `VARCHAR(20)` width on h2/hsqldb/mysql is worth checking since `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>` is a different shape.

---

## 5. Derivation/exposure — `OwnerMapper`

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`
This is where the derived DTO fields are computed. Imports CustomerCode, FiscalYear, Luhn, Locality, OwnerSegment (L10-16).
- `@Mapping` targets (L36-44): `membershipNumber`, `fiscalYear`, `checkDigit`, `locality`, `ownerSegment`, `identityKey`, etc.
- `membershipNumber(owner)` (L94-101): `String.format("%s-M%02d", customerCode, FiscalYear.shortYear(registrationDate))`; null until both customerCode and registrationDate set.
- `fiscalYear(owner)` (L105-107): `FiscalYear.label(registrationDate)`.
- `checkDigit(owner)` (L111-114): `Luhn.checkDigit(customerCode)`; null until code assigned.
- `locality(owner)` (L121-124): `CustomerCode.region(customerCode)`, falling back to `Locality.region(city, postcode)`.
- `timezone(owner)` (L129-131) depends on `locality`.
- `ownerSegment(owner)` (L149-151): `OwnerSegment.of(membershipLevel, locality(owner))`.

These five (`membershipNumber`, `checkDigit`, `locality`, `ownerSegment`, and `customerCode` itself) all read `getCustomerCode()` and are the direct consumers you must repoint to `memberId`.

---

## 6. Audit records referencing these fields

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`
`service` (L21-26): logs a human-readable line to the `AUDIT` logger including `customerCode={}` (`owner.getCustomerCode()`) and `membershipNumber={}` (`ownerMapper.membershipNumber(owner)`), plus id/registrationDate/membershipPoints/membershipLevel.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerCreatedEvent.java`
Immutable JSON audit record. Record component `String customerCode` (L13). `of(seq, owner)` (L20-23) sets it from `OwnerIdentity.primary(owner)` — so it already routes through the seam. Javadoc (L8-12) notes it will follow the memberId automatically.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreatedEvent.java`
Pipeline step (L14-16) that calls `publisher.publish(owner)`.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerCreatedEventPublisher.java`
`publish(owner)` (L32-35): builds `OwnerCreatedEvent.of(...)` and writes it as JSON to the `AUDIT` logger. Owns the monotonic sequence.

---

## 7. Membership-level machinery (uses FiscalYear/Tenure, not the code itself)

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Tenure.java`
`fiscalYears(registrationDate, asOf)` (L19-24) → `FiscalYear.between`. Feeds membership level.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignMembershipLevel.java` and `MembershipPoints.java`
Compute `membershipPoints`/`membershipLevel` (stored). `membershipLevel` feeds `OwnerSegment` and the audit event, but these files do not touch customerCode/membershipNumber directly. Included for completeness since they anchor the "membership" naming.

---

## 8. Related but tangential (share helpers, likely not renamed)

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/IdentityKey.java` — duplicate-detection key via `Sha256.hexLower`; different concept from customerCode HASH8 (uses telephone|email|soundex). Distinct from the identity code.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/Household.java:34` — uses `Sha256.hex(key, ID_LENGTH)` for `householdId`.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/SameCity.java:12` — a stale Javadoc `@see AssignOwnerCustomerCode derives the per-city sequence of the customer code` (comment only; the "per-city sequence" wording is out of date, code no longer uses a sequence). Worth updating during the rename.

---

## 9. API contract

package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner;

import java.time.LocalDate;

import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;

/**
 * Step of {@code POST /api/owners}: resolves the new owner's effective registration date and
 * ensures it falls on a business day. The effective date is the one supplied in the request,
 * or the server's current date when the request supplied none; either way, a weekend date is
 * rolled forward to the following Monday (see {@link BusinessDay}). Runs on the built owner so
 * both the persisted row and the response — and every value derived from the date, such as the
 * membership number's year segment — carry the adjusted value.
 */
public class ResolveOwnerRegistrationDate {

    public void service(@Val Owner owner) {
        LocalDate effective = owner.getRegistrationDate();
        if (effective == null) {
            effective = LocalDate.now();
        }
        owner.setRegistrationDate(BusinessDay.adjust(effective));
    }
}

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When supplied it is
            prefixed to the last name to compose the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g. street number
            and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized on input
            (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            apartment). Normalized on input like 'addressLine1' when supplied.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The owner's postal address. Accepted as flat input for backward compatibility, and
            always returned as the composed, normalized address (normalized 'addressLine1', plus
            a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the
            city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted on input in national or
            international form (spaces, dashes and brackets allowed); stored and returned
            in canonical E.164 form, e.g. '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted, and is returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied it
            drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Retained for backward compatibility and accepted but no longer acted upon:
            duplicate detection is now the single identity key (normalized telephone, email
            and soundex of the last name), so an additional household member with a different
            telephone or email already has a distinct identity key and is admitted without
            needing to opt in. Write-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'. Derived
                from the owner's id; absent until the owner has been persisted and assigned one.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the optional 'title' prefixed to the last
                name with a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or the last name alone when no
                title is on file.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                from 'telephone', which is kept in raw E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's assigned customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by
                the last name. Carries no sequence number and is stable for a given identity.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the customerCode; absent until it is
                assigned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household (same last name
                and postcode). Computed deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized last name, a '|' separator and the postcode, so
                owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Assigned
                to any owner that has a postcode; absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the full 64-character lower-case SHA-256 hex
                of '<normalizedTelephone>|<lower-cased email or empty>|<soundex(lastName)>'.
                The create endpoint's duplicate block is keyed on this value, rejecting a
                second owner with the same identity key (ignoring soft-deleted owners) with 409.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner shares an existing owner's postcode and a phonetically
                equal last name (same soundex) while having a different identity key; false
                otherwise. Fixed at registration and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one possibly duplicates (same postcode and
                soundex of last name, different identity key). Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                already shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Computed once at registration and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year of the registration date (the fiscal
                year starts 1 July). Derived from the owner's own customerCode and
                registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date, formatted
                'FY<YY>' from the last two digits of the calendar year in which the fiscal
                year starts (the fiscal year runs 1 July to 30 June, so a registration on
                1 July 2026 is 'FY26'). Absent until the registration date is set.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership score, fixed at registration. Starts at 0 and gains
                2 points for an email on file, 1 for no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for
                a household of 3 or more, and 3 for tenure over 1 fiscal year. Used to derive
                'membershipLevel'.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 fixed at registration and
                derived from 'membershipPoints': level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for
                4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, read back from the region segment of its customerCode.
                That region is derived at registration from the postcode range first (NSW
                2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), then the city-to-region table
                (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from its region ('locality') via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created on today's business
                day, signalling an unusually high signup volume; false otherwise. Evaluated
                against the current owners each time the owner is returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners, signalling
                that it is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; false otherwise. Evaluated
                against the current owners each time the owner is returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the fields on file:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band at its registration date, derived from 'birthDate':
                'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65 and over). Absent until
                a birth date is on file.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' and one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when 'membershipLevel' is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when
                the 'locality' is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                deleting the owner via DELETE marks it true while retaining the record, and
                the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks ignore deleted owners.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

info:
  title: Spring PetClinic

    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.

    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.

    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.

    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

      summary: Get a pet owner by ID

      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string

          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details

      parameters:
        - name: ownerId

          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32

        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.

        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.

            application/json:
              schema:

                type: string

        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:

          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When supplied it is
            prefixed to the last name to compose the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g. street number
            and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized on input
            (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            apartment). Normalized on input like 'addressLine1' when supplied.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The owner's postal address. Accepted as flat input for backward compatibility, and
            always returned as the composed, normalized address (normalized 'addressLine1', plus
            a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the
            city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted on input in national or
            international form (spaces, dashes and brackets allowed); stored and returned
            in canonical E.164 form, e.g. '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted, and is returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied it
            drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Retained for backward compatibility and accepted but no longer acted upon:
            duplicate detection is now the single identity key (normalized telephone, email
            and soundex of the last name), so an additional household member with a different
            telephone or email already has a distinct identity key and is admitted without
            needing to opt in. Write-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'. Derived
                from the owner's id; absent until the owner has been persisted and assigned one.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the optional 'title' prefixed to the last
                name with a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or the last name alone when no
                title is on file.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                from 'telephone', which is kept in raw E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is
                the region derived from the owner's postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal year of
                the registration date, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256
                over the normalized telephone followed by the last name, and CHK is a single
                Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On collision with an
                existing member id a '-<n>' suffix is appended. Stable for a given identity and
                registration year; assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household (same last name
                and postcode). Computed deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized last name, a '|' separator and the postcode, so
                owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Assigned
                to any owner that has a postcode; absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the full 64-character lower-case SHA-256 hex
                of '<normalizedTelephone>|<lower-cased email or empty>|<soundex(lastName)>'.
                The create endpoint's duplicate block is keyed on this value, rejecting a
                second owner with the same identity key (ignoring soft-deleted owners) with 409.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner shares an existing owner's postcode and a phonetically
                equal last name (same soundex) while having a different identity key; false
                otherwise. Fixed at registration and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one possibly duplicates (same postcode and
                soundex of last name, different identity key). Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                already shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Computed once at registration and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year of the registration date (the fiscal
                year starts 1 July). Derived from the owner's own customerCode and
                registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date, formatted
                'FY<YY>' from the last two digits of the calendar year in which the fiscal
                year starts (the fiscal year runs 1 July to 30 June, so a registration on
                1 July 2026 is 'FY26'). Absent until the registration date is set.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership score, fixed at registration. Starts at 0 and gains
                2 points for an email on file, 1 for no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for
                a household of 3 or more, and 3 for tenure over 1 fiscal year. Used to derive
                'membershipLevel'.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 fixed at registration and
                derived from 'membershipPoints': level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for
                4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, read back from the region segment of its customerCode.
                That region is derived at registration from the postcode range first (NSW
                2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), then the city-to-region table
                (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from its region ('locality') via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created on today's business
                day, signalling an unusually high signup volume; false otherwise. Evaluated
                against the current owners each time the owner is returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners, signalling
                that it is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; false otherwise. Evaluated
                against the current owners each time the owner is returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the fields on file:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band at its registration date, derived from 'birthDate':
                'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65 and over). Absent until
                a birth date is on file.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' and one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when 'membershipLevel' is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when
                the 'locality' is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                deleting the owner via DELETE marks it true while retaining the record, and
                the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks ignore deleted owners.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:

          type: string

          maxLength: 30

        lastName:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"

          maxLength: 255

        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-

            apartment). Normalized on input like 'addressLine1' when supplied.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        address:
          title: Address

            always returned as the composed, normalized address (normalized 'addressLine1', plus
            a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'

          title: City

          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'

          title: Telephone number

The build passes with all tests green. The refactor is complete.

## Summary

I unified `customerCode` and `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId` formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, and removed the standalone `checkDigit`.

**New / renamed logic**
- **`MemberId`** (replaces `CustomerCode`): the single definition of the id. `format(region, registrationDate, telephone, lastName)` builds `<REGION>` + 2-digit `<FY>` (via `FiscalYear.shortYear`) + `<HASH8>` (the same `Sha256.hex(telephone+lastName, 8)` used by the region-and-hash identity) + `<CHK>` (a `Luhn` check digit over the digits of `<REGION><FY><HASH8>`). It also parses `region(id)` and `fiscalYear(id)` back out, and keeps the `-<n>` collision dedup.
- **`AssignMemberId`** (replaces `AssignOwnerCustomerCode`): derives region, formats the id, and dedups against existing `memberId`s. Collision handling now applies to the memberId.

**Repointed consumers**
- `OwnerMapper`: dropped `membershipNumber`/`checkDigit`; `fiscalYear` now reads the FY segment out of `memberId`, and `locality` (which feeds `ownerSegment`) reads the region out of `memberId`.
- `OwnerIdentity.primary` → `owner.getMemberId()`, so `OwnerCreatedEvent` (component renamed to `memberId`) and `AuditOwnerCreated`'s human-readable line both reference the memberId; the audit step no longer needs the mapper.
- `FiscalYear` lost the now-unused `label` method; stale javadoc references in `Sha256`, `SameCity`, `Luhn` updated.

**Persistence / contract**
- `Owner`: `customerCode`/`customer_code` → `memberId`/`member_id`; schema column renamed to `member_id` (widened to `VARCHAR(32)`/`TEXT`) across h2/hsqldb/mysql/postgres.
- `openapi.yml`: `customerCode`, `checkDigit`, `membershipNumber` schemas removed; `memberId` added; `fiscalYear`/`locality` descriptions now say "read back from … its memberId".
- Pipeline YAML step renamed `assignCustomerCode` → `assignMemberId`.

The acceptance test (`memberId` starts with `NSW`, contains the SHA-256 HASH8, and the old fields are gone) passes — verified in the audit line `memberId=NSW2616E6609E3` (NSW · 26 · 16E6609E · 3).
